description.zh: 蝸牛白天向上爬 a 公尺、晚上下滑 b 公尺（a > b）。井深 h 公尺，問幾天能爬出井口？
description.en: A snail climbs a meters by day and slips b meters by night (a > b). Given well depth h, find days to escape.

hint.zh: 第一天結束已在 a 公尺；之後每天淨增 a - b。
hint.en: After day 1 the snail is at a; each later day net gain is a - b.
